definitions.explanation: A paradoxical statement or question used in Zen Buddhism (especially the {臨済|りんざい} school) as an object of meditation, aimed at provoking insight beyond ordinary logical thought.

examples.japanese: ⟦{禅|ぜん}→禅：03757_zen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{公案|こうあん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: I work on a Zen koan.

examples.japanese: 「{隻手|せきしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{公案|こうあん}だ。
examples.english: "The sound of one hand" is a famous koan.

examples.japanese: {臨済宗|りんざいしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{師|し}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{与|あた}えられた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧{公案|こうあん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{向|む}き{合|あ}い→向き合う：04652_mukiau⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: In Rinzai-school training, you are required to wrestle for years with a koan given to you by your master.

notes:
Originally a Tang-dynasty Chinese legal term meaning "public case," later adapted by Chan/Zen masters to refer to recorded teaching dialogues used for meditation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公案|こうあん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to work on a koan
- {公案|こうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧: to resolve a koan (informal; koans aren't really "solved" in a logical sense)
- {公案|こうあん}⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧: koan training
- ⟦{禅|ぜん}→禅：03757_zen⟧{公案|こうあん}: Zen koan

CULTURAL NOTE:
Famous examples include {隻手|せきしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧ ("the sound of one hand") by Hakuin and {趙州|じょうしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ ("Joshu's Mu"). Koan study is central to Rinzai Zen but plays a smaller role in the Soto school.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- なぞなぞ: riddle — playful and entertaining; lacks the religious dimension
- {禅問答|ぜんもんどう}: Zen dialogue — sometimes used loosely to mean a baffling exchange
